hook: In 1926, the National Bank of Czechoslovakia opened its doors exactly 100 years ago.

sections.voiceover: In 1926, the National Bank of Czechoslovakia opened its doors exactly 100 years ago.
b_roll: Historical bank building facade in Prague

sections.voiceover: Spring marked the centenary of the legal predecessor to the modern central bank. Operations began on April 1, 1926. Where did the institution build its foundation?
b_roll: Early currency notes of the Czechoslovak koruna

sections.voiceover: Frait raised the stakes in Prague, but new challenges in central banking loomed.
b_roll: Bank for International Settlements conference hall

sections.voiceover: Jan Frait delivered opening remarks on October 6, 2026. The institution celebrated its milestone alongside post-Bretton Woods system milestones.
b_roll: Delegates seated at the central banking conference

sections.voiceover: The Czech National Bank officially reached the year 2026 after a century of evolution.
